card.name: Non-Latin script characters in etymologies
card.fires_on: Broken-up bytes or letters of non-Latin scripts (Greek, Lao, Gurmukhi) and accented phonetic letters, mostly in word origins and etymology notes.

modes.label: Partial Greek or Indic bytes
modes.description: Fires on a split piece of a Greek or Indic letter inside a quoted original word.

modes.label: Phonetic or Greek letters
modes.description: Fires on accented pronunciation letters or a Greek letter used in a term.

card.writes: Weak; it favors Chinese and Latin-script fragments such as 'ru' and 'INFO', so no clear meaning.
card.plain: It fires when a word is written in a foreign alphabet, such as Greek, in a word-origin note.
